description: This file contains tests for the 'wheel' (mouse wheel) event handling in Playwright. It includes various test cases to verify wheel event dispatching, scrolling behavior, modifier keys, event cancellation, and compatibility with different elements like SVG. The tests ensure that wheel events are correctly dispatched, processed, and can trigger scrolling or be prevented as expected.

methods.name: async function expectEvent(page: Page, expected: any) { expectEvent
methods.description: A helper function that polls for the last wheel event on the page and compares it with the expected event object, optionally ignoring delta values if specified.

methods.name: async function listenForWheelEvents(page: Page, selector: string) { listenForWheelEvents
methods.description: Injects a script into the page to listen for wheel events on a given selector and store event details in window['lastEvent'].
